304-822-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
304-822-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
304-822-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tough Cookie.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

997-3478-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

372-1621-5694.manaNeeded: {6}{C}{C}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-5694.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

849-997-1580-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2033-2079-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-2079-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-2079-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-3480-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4390-5078-6757-7356-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6757-7356-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot and Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

152-5231-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven multicolored permanents.
152-5231-6741.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Robots, adding seven {R}.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-7356.notablePrerequisites: You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3532-4997-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

2203-2366-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3088-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-3088-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

2438-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2438-6701--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2292-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2292-3560-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1690-2510-2538-5034.notablePrerequisites:
There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
1690-2510-2538-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2510-2538-5034.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1651-5469-5491.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Map token and your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-2557-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

997-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

116-2569-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Progenitor Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-2665.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Progenitor Mimic.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by tapping it.
When Progenitor Mimic becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Progenitor Mimic's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

722-804-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1770-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1770-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

643-969-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
643-969-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1110-3046.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Overgrown Armasaur indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
1110-3046.description:
Give Overgrown Armasaur indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
Overgrown Armasaur triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Overgrown Armasaur.
Repeat from step 3.

932-3094-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has three charge counters on it.
932-3094-3609.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter, removing 3 charge counters to take an extra turn.
Activate Lithoform Engine, copying the extra turn ability.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Energy Chamber triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter, putting a charge counter on itself.
Activate Lithoform Engine, copying the trigger.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
